title: Code type
summary: Code writes itself in an editor in the brand's colours; the camera rides the caret close, then the line that matters lights up.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: highlight
params.description: the line (1-based) that lights up at the end

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add code-type --name my-code-type
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-code-type/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-code-type/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: show how little code it takes
